EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the history PhD at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University's doctoral history program through the School of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies. We are excited that you are considering joining the ASU community. Here is some information to get you started on your journey:
Program description and admission requirements: https://shprs.clas.asu.edu/graduate/history-phd
Public history information: https://shprs.clas.asu.edu/public-history
History graduate faculty: https://graduate.asu.edu/graduate-faculty/degree/LAHISTPHD
History faculty research areas: https://shprs.asu.edu/content/history-3
Please review these sites closely, then contact me at Lindseyplaitjones@asu.edu with any additional questions you may have.
Sincerely,
Lindsey Plait Jones Graduate Program Coordinator School of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
